notes:
能连上 GitHub 时从 GitHub 下载，连不上再自动改用国内镜像，中间不提示。指南 Mod 改成小块下载后拼合，不再从镜像拉整份约 344 MB。目录和启动时的更新检查在 12 小时内不再重复请求。
Downloads come from GitHub when it can be reached, and switch to the domestic mirror when it cannot, with no prompt. The guide mod is downloaded in pieces and reassembled, instead of pulling the whole 344 MB file from the mirror. Catalog and startup update checks stay quiet for 12 hours.
